cd /tmp && cat > iterative_repair.py << 'PYEOF'
import RNA, random, itertools

sub0 = "(((((((....((..((..(((..((..((..((..((..((..((...)).))..)).)).))..)).))).)).)))))))))"
seq = list("CCGGAUUAUAGCAAAGUAGACGACGCGAUUGACCGAGAUAUCUUCCGCAGGUGAAAUCAGGAGAAGGCUCGUAACAUGGAUCCGG")

def fold(s):
    fc = RNA.fold_compound(s); return fc.mfe()
def diag(s):
    mf,e = fold(s)
    pt_t = RNA.ptable(sub0); pt_m = RNA.ptable(mf)
    missing=[]; spurious=[]
    for i in range(1,len(s)+1):
        if pt_t[i]>i and pt_m[i]!=pt_t[i]: missing.append((i-1,pt_t[i]-1))
        if pt_m[i]>i and pt_t[i]!=pt_m[i]: spurious.append((i-1,pt_m[i]-1))
    return mf, missing, spurious

# target pairs set
target_pairs = set()
pt_t = RNA.ptable(sub0)
for i in range(1,len(sub0)+1):
    if pt_t[i]>i: target_pairs.add((i-1,pt_t[i]-1))
target_paired_pos = set(p[0] for p in target_pairs) | set(p[1] for p in target_pairs)

best = ''.join(seq)
best_mf, best_miss, best_spur = diag(best)
print("start:", best_mf==sub0, "miss:", best_miss, "spur:", best_spur)

# iterative: at each step, for each spurious pair, try mutating ONE of its positions
# (prefer unpaired-in-target positions; mutate to break complementarity with partner).
random.seed(0)
for it in range(200):
    mf, miss, spur = diag(best)
    if not miss and not spur:
        print("SOLVED at iter", it); break
    cur_best = best
    cur_score = (len(miss)+len(spur),)
    improved=False
    # focus on spurious first
    targets = spur + miss
    for (i,j) in spur:
        for pos in (i,j):
            for nt in "ACGU":
                if best[pos]==nt: continue
                cand = list(best); cand[pos]=nt; cand=''.join(cand)
                mf2,m2,s2 = diag(cand)
                sc = (len(m2)+len(s2), len(s2), -RNA.fold_compound(cand).mfe()[1])
                if sc < cur_score:
                    cur_score = sc; cur_best = cand; improved=True
    if not improved:
        # random kick on a spurious or missing position
        if spur:
            i,j = spur[0]
            pos = random.choice([i,j])
            cand = list(best); cand[pos]=random.choice("ACGU"); cand=''.join(cand)
            cur_best = cand
    best = cur_best
    mf, miss, spur = diag(best)
    if it % 20 == 0:
        print(f"it{it}: miss={len(miss)} spur={len(spur)} match={mf==sub0}")

mf, miss, spur = diag(best)
print("FINAL:", mf==sub0, "miss:", miss, "spur:", spur)
print("seq:", best)

content.text:
The two identical units are complementary to each other (unit0 read in reverse is its own complement roughly), so the whole thing forms one giant inter-unit helix instead of two hairpins. I must make unit 1 NOT the reverse-complement of unit 0. Solution: use a different solved sequence for unit 1, OR redesign unit 1 with different pair composition so it's not self-complementary across units.

The cleanest fix: design unit1 as a different sequence that still folds to the sub_target but is not the complement of unit0. Since unit0 has G on the left and C on the right, unit1 should have C on the left and G on the right (mirror orientation). Let me re-run the iterative repair for unit1 with mirrored pair orientations.

Actually simpler: I need the LEFT half and RIGHT half of the full sequence to be non-complementary. Unit0 occupies the left half (pos 3-87). Unit1 occupies right half (96-180). For the full sequence not to form cross-helices, unit1 should not equal reverse-complement of unit0. 

Let me create a variant of the solved unit0 by swapping G↔C in all pairs (mirroring orientation), which makes unit1 = the complement-swapped version. Then unit0 (G-left/C-right) and unit1 (C-left/G-right) won't be cross-complementary.

The complement-swapped seq1 doesn't fold to sub0 (because swapping G↔C everywhere changed unpaired bases too, breaking the triloop and linkers). I need to mirror pair ORIENTATIONS only, keeping unpaired bases. Let me re-solve unit1 fresh with mirrored pair orientation, then assemble.

Better approach: just run the iterative repair solver but with a different random seed and constraint that it differs from reverse-complement of unit0. Actually, simplest: run iterative_repair again with a different seed to get an independent seq1.

input.command:
cd /tmp && cat > solve_unit1.py << 'PYEOF'
import RNA, random

sub0 = "(((((((....((..((..(((..((..((..((..((..((..((...)).))..)).)).))..)).))).)).)))))))))"
# start from a different initial random sequence
def fold(s):
    fc = RNA.fold_compound(s); return fc.mfe()
def diag(s):
    mf,e = fold(s)
    pt_t = RNA.ptable(sub0); pt_m = RNA.ptable(mf)
    missing=[]; spurious=[]
    for i in range(1,len(s)+1):
        if pt_t[i]>i and pt_m[i]!=pt_t[i]: missing.append((i-1,pt_t[i]-1))
        if pt_m[i]>i and pt_t[i]!=pt_m[i]: spurious.append((i-1,pt_m[i]-1))
    return mf, missing, spurious

target_pairs=set()
pt_t=RNA.ptable(sub0)
for i in range(1,len(sub0)+1):
    if pt_t[i]>i: target_pairs.add((i-1,pt_t[i]-1))

# init: paired positions get G-C mirrored (left=C,right=G), unpaired A
seq=['A']*85
for (i,j) in target_pairs:
    seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'
# triloop cap
# find hairpin loop positions (unpaired between i and j where i,j is innermost pair)
# innermost pair in sub0
inner = min(target_pairs, key=lambda p: p[1]-p[0])
li,lj = inner
# loop positions = li+1..lj-1
loop_pos = list(range(li+1,lj))
print("inner pair:", inner, "loop:", loop_pos)
# set triloop GAA
for k,p in enumerate(loop_pos):
    seq[p] = "GAA"[k]
# closing pair C-G
seq[li]='C'; seq[lj]='G'

best=''.join(seq)
random.seed(42)
mf,miss,spur=diag(best)
print("init match:", mf==sub0, "miss:",miss,"spur:",spur)

for it in range(2000):
    mf, miss, spur = diag(best)
    if not miss and not spur:
        print("SOLVED at iter", it); break
    cur_score=(len(miss)+len(spur),)
    cur_best=best; improved=False
    for (i,j) in spur+miss:
        for pos in (i,j):
            for nt in "ACGU":
                if best[pos]==nt: continue
                cand=list(best); cand[pos]=nt; cand=''.join(cand)
                mf2,m2,s2=diag(cand)
                sc=(len(m2)+len(s2), len(s2))
                if sc<cur_score:
                    cur_score=sc; cur_best=cand; improved=True
    if not improved:
        # random kick
        if spur:
            i,j=spur[0]; pos=random.choice([i,j])
        elif miss:
            i,j=miss[0]; pos=random.choice([i,j])
        else:
            pos=random.randint(0,84)
        cand=list(best); cand[pos]=random.choice("ACGU"); cand=''.join(cand)
        cur_best=cand
    best=cur_best

mf,miss,spur=diag(best)
print("FINAL unit1:", mf==sub0, "miss:",miss,"spur:",spur)
print("seq1:", best)
